features.name: Create React frontend
features.description: Create the React application that will be served locally and rendered by the Avalonia host.
completion_criteria: The frontend directory and package manifest exist.
The selected package manager and development commands are documented.
The production frontend build succeeds.
Frontend verification commands are added to init.ps1 and init.sh.

features.name: Add PicoServer support to Host
features.description: Integrate PicoServer into the Host and expose the local API surface needed by the web UI.
completion_criteria: Host starts and stops PicoServer with the application lifecycle.
The local server address and port behavior are documented.
A backend ping endpoint or handler returns pong.
Relevant Host build or automated checks pass.

features.name: Render React UI in Avalonia WebView
features.description: Replace or adapt the native shell so that it loads the locally served React application in a WebView.
completion_criteria: The Desktop Host displays the React application in a WebView.
Startup ordering prevents the WebView from loading before PicoServer is ready.
Load failures are surfaced or logged.
The Desktop Host build succeeds.

features.name: Complete ping-pong integration
features.description: Implement and verify one end-to-end request from the React UI through PicoServer to Host.
completion_criteria: The React UI can send ping.
Host returns pong through PicoServer.
The React UI displays the pong response.
The interaction works inside the Avalonia WebView.
Verification evidence is recorded in progress.md.

features.name: Close Phase 1 MVP
features.description: Make the completed MVP reproducible for the next developer or agent session.
completion_criteria: Both initialization scripts verify all available frontend and Host checks.
README.md documents setup, run, and ping-pong verification steps.
All earlier Phase 1 features contain completion evidence.
progress.md and session-handoff.md contain no unresolved MVP blocker.
